candidate: BONC (东方国信) Horinger Intelligent Computing Centre: the BONC Industrial Internet Northern Regional Center (东方国信工业互联网北方区域中心) campus in the Yungu area of Horinger New Area, Hohhot, Inner Mongolia
method: The selected point is the station-centre coordinate of the campus's planned 2# 110 kV substation, printed in geographic degrees-minutes-seconds in the environmental impact report form published with the Hohhot Ecology and Environment Bureau acceptance notice of 26 August 2025. It was transcribed arithmetically to decimal degrees (deg + min/60 + sec/3600) with no datum transformation. The same report gives the four corner coordinates of the substation footprint in the 2000 national system (CGCS2000) as Gauss-Kruger grid values. Read as the 3-degree zone with central meridian 111 deg E (EPSG:4546) and converted with pyproj 3.7.1, their centroid falls 1.44 m from the printed geographic centre. The corners enclose 1,151.5 m2, which is the 49 m x 23.5 m footprint of the substation building given in the report. The printed geographic coordinates are therefore CGCS2000, which agrees with WGS84 to well under a metre. Precedent for the scope class: official_eia_on_campus_substation_locator (China Telecom Shaotang; Zhongwei West Cloud Base and Xuanhe).

bonc_horinger_campus.on_campus_statement: The report places the 2# 110 kV substation inside the BONC Industrial Internet Northern Regional Center plant area, in its central-east part (厂区内中部东侧 / 中部靠东侧), with no new land take. The substation was planned and not yet built when the report was written (August 2025). Appended figure 3 marks it on the campus site plan.

cgcs2000_corner_check.crs_reading: EPSG:4546 (CGCS2000 / 3-degree Gauss-Kruger CM 111E; the easting carries no zone prefix)

synthesis_check: The printed coordinates were re-extracted from the hashed PDF capture with pdftotext. The decimal values and the CGCS2000 corner conversion were recomputed with uv run --no-project --with pyproj==3.7.1 --with shapely==2.1.1 python -I.
registration_check: Qualitative check in an Esri World Imagery export (EPSG:4326, 111.800-111.822E, 40.533-40.548N; local esri-bonc-horinger.jpg; imagery dates not stated). The point falls in the central-east, largely unbuilt part of a road-bounded block. Built data-hall buildings occupy the west part of the block, a residential compound adjoins it to the east, and an east-west road separates it from the large China Mobile Hohhot data-centre block to the south. This matches the report, which puts the 克略和苑 residential compound 62 m east of the substation wall. The CGCS2000 corner check above is the quantitative datum check; the imagery check is not a measured accuracy.

uncertainty: The datum and transcription are checked: the printed point agrees with the report's own CGCS2000 corner coordinates to 1.4 m. Its survey accuracy is not stated. The point marks the planned 2# substation in the central-east of the 130,939 m2 plant area, not an operating data-centre building; the campus extends a few hundred metres around it, and the 1# substation terminals lie about 310 m west-north-west.
